IGUI_BU_Status: %1 item types, %2 with nowhere to go. %3 containers in the base.
IGUI_BU_Hint: Drag types onto a container (Ctrl/Shift-click to pick several). Ctrl while dropping: just these items, this run. Untouched types go where their kind already is, then the nearest free container.
IGUI_BU_NoZone: Near here, no zone drawn (%1 containers)
IGUI_BU_NoZoneNote: Draw your base with the Zones button to list only what is in it
IGUI_BU_ZonesTip: Draw, rename and remove the base zones. Only containers inside a base zone near what you unload are listed and used.
IGUI_BU_ZoneHelp1: Pieces with the same name are one zone: draw an L-shaped house as two.
IGUI_BU_ZoneHelp2: A zone takes in %1 floors above and below the one it is drawn on.
IGUI_BU_ZoneNameAsk: Name this zone (an existing name adds this piece to it)
IGUI_BU_ZoneRenameAsk: Rename this piece (an existing name joins it to that zone)
IGUI_BU_StockStatus: %1 items in %2 rows, %3 zones. Hover to light a container up, double-click to walk to it.
IGUI_BU_StockStale: Grey rows are from zones out of range, as last counted.
IGUI_BU_StockNoZones: No base zones yet: press Zones to draw your base.
IGUI_BU_AutoTagTip: Every listed container takes the categories of what it already holds. Hidden and off-limits containers are left alone.
IGUI_BU_ClearAllTags: Clear the categories of every container in this base
IGUI_BU_ClearAllTagsAsk: Clear the categories of all %1 tagged containers in this base? Hidden and off-limits ones too. Assignments stay.
IGUI_BU_OffLimitsOn: Off limits: only what I drag here
IGUI_BU_SendUnassigned: Send every type without a rule here
IGUI_BU_Stuck: Unloading stopped: nothing could be moved
IGUI_BU_LeaveVehicle: Get out of the vehicle first
IGUI_BU_SourceGone: The container you were unloading is gone
IGUI_BU_TooHeavy: %1 items too heavy to carry without going past the load limit
